title: write-back and termination
description: User story under REQ-186. Every answer lands through a verb and the loop ends at the computed verdict, so nothing about intent lives only in a chat.
iWant: every answer to land through a verb and the loop to end at the computed verdict
soThat: nothing about my intent lives only in a chat

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given the scripted loop fixture, when every writeBack the question set returns is applied and readiness recomputed each turn, then the question count strictly decreases every turn and reaches zero.
[happy] given a statement resolved to a newly created REQ carrying description and domain, when readiness recomputes, then skeleton:reqIntent passes that REQ and stories:reqHasUs asks for it once.
[happy] given a tree at L1, when [draft] entities, TAC stubs and interfaces are added, then levels.intentComplete.ok stays true and the product-owner question set stays empty.
[failure] given an openQuestion promoted to a decision with one option and no default, when readiness recomputes, then decisions:wellFormed asks once and brief:openQuestions does not.
[must-not] given any product-owner check, when readiness recomputes after an engineer-only edit, then no product-owner check changes from ok to failing.
